content: Pɔl u Masɛdwan anà u Ngɛlɛsi
Mpal làwü làso lanswà, Pɔl kàtüüb alɔŋki. Ungö mukapà ngwal, laa kàsawɛy nde, waa kàkyen Masɛdwan.
Nde kàlyaaŋ kà in'tà amin mupà alɔŋki ngwal unsà an'yääm mbɔɔn. Ungö nde kàkyen Ngɛlɛsi
mper kàkyer nde ngɔɔn tär. Nde kàbön muwal an'swà ntɔn mukyà Siri, wɛɛ Ayudà bàdirà mukun'kyer ube. Undiiràwun kàsɔɔm nde an'kyän mufàsoonà u Masɛdwan.

Baar bàkyen muyisal anà nde tii kà Azi babà: Sɔpatrɔs, mwan baal a Pirüs un'nsi Bɛrɛ, Aristark anà Sɛgɔn ansi Tɛsalɔnikà, Gayüs un'nsi Dɛrbɛ, Tumàtɛ anà Tishik anà Trɔfim baar a un'tà a Azi.
Ba banswà bàkyen kusà a bi, ba bàkidil u Tɔlɔwasi.
Wɛɛ bi, bi Filipe kàlwomà ungö a ilä a mampà iköön ful, bi kàbilà kà an'swà mukàtaan ba ungö a ilä ityeen u Tɔlowasi, ikal kàkyer bi ilä nsambwaar.
Ndeer a Pɔl yà ntsüü u Tɔlɔwasi
Ilä atàtwɛb ungö a saba, bi kàkäl ikal imwɛy ntɔn mutsul mampà, Pɔl kàkäl muyäämà anà ba. Ntɔn ya yàlɔ̈m naa nde akyà taaŋtyà, nde kàläb an'yääm ndaay tii uboboo a mpib.
Minà myàkäl mbɔɔn u suk adu kàköŋ bi.

Kyekà, un'tö mwɛy ikɔb ande Ötik, kàkäl wàŋàbwaay u mun a nɛl. Umpal kàkäl Pɔl mulab an'yääm ndaay, nde kàkuur a twaal. Twaal alà lun'syen nkuur, waa kàbü fà ndwà yàtär udu. Mpal bun'suub ba, nde kàkäl wàŋàkwà.
Pɔl laa kàtɔlà nde, waa kàkyà ntiin mper kàkäl un'tö awà. Nde kun'wɛl kà an'kɔɔ, waa kàtɛn naa: « Twɔn lan'tɛɛr, mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande wà mwo! »
Ungö mubeenà, Pɔl, kàtsül làmpà, waa kàdi. Apan, waa kàfàlab an'yääm tii làtyà taaŋ. Apan, laa kàkyen nde.
Wɛɛ akà un'tö awà, ba bun'syen anà mɔ̈ɔ̈. Ya yàpɛ ngwal mbɔɔn akà baar banswà.
Nkyeen Milɛ fà Tɔlɔwasi
Wɛɛ bi, bi kàwɛl an'swà kusà mukyà Asɔsi, bul kàkàwal bi Pɔl, ntɔn nde kàkwen mukyà u mbwo a mɛɛn.
Mpal kàyitaan nde u Asɔsi, bi kun'wɛl kà an'swà ntɔn mukyà Mitilɛn.
Fà apan, bi kàläb mbwo a an'dà taaŋtyà, bi kàkàtol tsütsü a Kyɔ. Ilä kyàlääb pa, bi kàsoonà u Samɔsi. Ungö a ilä mwɛy, bi kàtöl Milɛ ungö mukɔm u Trɔzilyɔn.
Ntɔn, Pɔl kàkwen mulyaaŋ ifaŋ kà Ԑfɛsɔ, ntɔn mukɔɔn adwa taaŋ kà Azi: nde kàdüül mukal u Yɛlusàlɛm ilä a Pantɛkɔt, kya mbwo yàlàkal.
An'yääm anà andweer a Ɛfɛsɔ
Mpalàbà, u Milɛ, Pɔl kàtöm baar mukàbel andweer a Ikööŋ a Ԑfɛsɔ.
Utaaŋ bàyàkɔlà ba apà nde, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Bɛ, bɛ làkyàyöb naa mɛ anà bɛ in'fàkal aben sɛmà ilä atàtwɛb kàtɔ̈l mɛ Azi.
Mɛ kàsyääl Mwol unsà làbɔ̈ɔ̈n lanswà uboo a nsaaŋ anà uboo a in'taam myàfü u ndiirà a Ayudà.
Mɛ kàyee anki akà undiir mwɛy kan'kwo mukal wàndöŋ ntɔn bɛ. Wɛɛ mɛ kàkyer alakyään anà kàkyer alalɔŋ u mii a baar anà uboo a ndwà,
mukyään Ayudà anà Angɛlɛki mbuul a mpem akà Nzam anà musà làkwikilà amu Mwol abi Yɛsu.
Wɛɛ apanà, mɛ, mɛ in'wà aŋàbämà anà Dweelà, lalan in'kyà mɛ Yɛlusàlɛm, ukɔɔn ayöb naa ndaa nà ikan'bweel kwo.
Wɛɛ undiir mwɛy mpɛl Dweelà In'kyɛɛl ukan'swaŋà: u bul lanswà in'siŋ anà mpay aŋàkir yàmukan'diilà.
Wɛɛ akà mɛ, mɛ ndöŋ mbɔɔn in'paa anki akà mɔ̈ɔ̈ amɛ, undiir mwɛy awà kan'söön ubwaŋ wà mulab mbwo amɛ anà mumay isal kan'pɛ Mwol Yɛsu: utà imbäl a Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là kab a ngway a Nzam.
Sɛmà apanà, mɛ, mɛ in'kyàyöb naa bɛ ntabwey amɛ làyàfàman anki, bɛ banswà baar abà kàlyaaŋà mɛ uboo a bɛ muyikyään Imwol a Nzam.
Lalan, mɛ, mɛ an'kwo in'tɛ imbäl ŋàbawà kusà a bɛ naa umwɛy uboo abɛ usadiimà mbwo, nsaŋ ande ŋakwo.
Ntɔn mɛ akà undiir mwɛy kàyee anki, wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ kàlakyään an'kyän a Nzam manswà.
Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ ntɔn bɛ ŋakwo anà ntɔn làböl kàlapɛ Dweelà In'kyɛɛl muler, làkäl aseey a Ikööŋ a Nzam kàwɛl nde u mbwo a an'kil ande ŋakwo.
Mɛ, mɛ inkyàyöb naa ungö a nkyeen amɛ, in'kyɛŋ a nkyɛl mpa myàsàwem ngyɛb a làböl myàkyer asàbilà uboo a bɛ,
itàkal uboo a itsuŋ abɛ ŋakwo baar bàkyer asàmbarà mutɛn ndaa a loor ntɔn alɔŋki baläb.
Lalan, làtsim, làyöb naa u mbul tär, mpib anà mwäänà, isal amɛ kyàkäl mutɛn a bɛ anà nsaaŋ u mii.
« Waa apanà, mɛ amàlapà kà an'kɔɔ a Nzam anà akà ndaa a kab a ngway ande alye anà ngwal atɔŋ anà mupà kwal akà baar aŋàkyɛɛl banswà.
Mɛ kàsàwem anki un'köl ntɔn ngim itàkal wɔl itàkal ipfey a mbuur.
Bɛ, bɛ ŋakwo làkyàyöb naa an'kɔɔ mà, ma màsäl ntɔn indiir kàkäl bi abyà ndöŋ, mɛ anà baar bàkäl anà mɛ.
Mɛ kàlaswɛŋ taaŋ lanswà naa yubwaŋ musal abun ntɔn mubay baar abà u ngyal, muyɔbà ndaa kàtɛn Mwol Yɛsu ŋakwo naa: "Un'sak afàkal mbɔɔn mupà akwànaa muwal!" »
Ungö mutɛn abwɛy, nde kàbü an'köm mbwo mwɛy anà ba banswà, waa kàyamà.
Apan ba banswà waa bàlel, bun'bweel u bway ntɔn mukundüür.
Ngyɛb aba yàmbɔɔn yàfü unsà ndaa kàtɛn nde naa ba ntabwey ande bàfàsàman anki. Apan ba bàkun'swà tii kà an'swà.
